run_pixel_art_video: run pixel art video to overlay procedural animations onto a source image and encode to MP4
create_pixel_art_night_scene: create a pixel art night scene with stars, fireflies, and leaves animations over a base image
create_pixel_art_storm_scene: create a pixel art storm scene with rain and lightning effects over a base image
create_pixel_art_snow_scene: create a pixel art snow scene with snowflakes and sparkles animations over a base image
create_pixel_art_video_gif: create a pixel art video with MP4 output and export an additional GIF file
